reversal.name: Short-term bounce
reversal.desc: Stocks that fell more than their sector over the last 5 days tend to bounce back.

momentum.name: 3-month momentum
momentum.desc: Stocks that rose steadily over ~3 months (ignoring the last week) tend to keep going.

meanrev.name: Rubber band
meanrev.desc: How far the price is stretched below its 20-day average, measured in volatility units.

pressure.name: Closing pressure
pressure.desc: Closing above the day's average price (VWAP) means buyers were in control late in the day.

volume.name: Volume confirmation
volume.desc: Unusual volume in the direction of the move signals that big players are active.

calm.name: Low volatility
calm.desc: Calm, steady stocks often deliver better risk-adjusted returns than wild ones.

quality.name: Trend quality
quality.desc: Return divided by volatility over 20 days: a smooth uptrend beats a jumpy one.

sector.name: Sector rotation
sector.desc: NEPSE moves in sector waves; favour stocks whose whole sector is gaining strength.
